children: Bank of Hope received all required regulatory approvals for its acquisition of the Commercial Banking Unit of SMBC MANUBANK.
Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation approved the transaction.
Acquisition expected to close early in Q4 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Deal aims to diversify deposits, strengthen commercial banking capabilities and expand Greater Los Angeles presence.
Bank of Hope and SMBC will enter a partnership to serve Japan-based middle market and retail customers in the U.S. upon closing.
